Article.ArticleTitle: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma of the mediastinum: CT and 18 F-fluoro-2-deoxyglucose PET findings.

Abstract.AbstractText: Mediastinal follicular dendritic cell sarcoma (FDCS) is an exceedingly rare malignant tumor. We report, herein, detailed imaging findings of mediastinal FDCS, appearing as a large, well-circumscribed, strongly enhancing mass with central coarse calcification on computed tomography, with moderately increased metabolic activity on 18 F-fluoro-2-deoxyglucose positron emission tomography.
